title: Constitutive parameterized deep energy method for solid mechanics problems with random material parameters
abstract: arXiv:2603.26030v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In practical structural design and solid mechanics simulations, material properties inherently exhibit random variations within bounded intervals. However, evaluating mechanical responses under continuous material uncertainty remains a persistent challenge. Traditional numerical approaches, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), incur prohibitive computational costs as they require repeated mesh discretization and equation solving for every parametric realization. Similarly, data-driven surrogate models depend heavily on massive, high-fidelity datasets, while standard physics-informed frameworks (e.g., the Deep Energy Method) strictly demand complete retraining from scratch whenever material parameters change. To bridge this critical gap, we propose the Constitutive Parameterized Deep Energy Method (CPDEM). translated_title: 面向随机材料参数固体力学问题的本构参数化深度能量方法
translated_abstract: 在实际结构设计和固体力学仿真中，材料属性固有地在有界区间内表现出随机变化。然而，在连续材料不确定性条件下评估力学响应仍然是一个持续的挑战。传统数值方法（如有限元法（FEM））的计算成本极其高昂，因为它们需要对每一个参数化实现重复进行网格离散化和方程求解。同样，数据驱动的代理模型严重依赖大规模、高保真度的数据集，而标准的物理驱动框架（如深度能量方法）在材料参数发生变化时则严格要求从头开始完全重新训练。为了弥合这一关键差距，我们提出了本构参数化深度能量方法（CPDEM）。在这一纯物理驱动的框架中，应变能密度泛函通过编码潜在代表性表示被重新构建……（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出本构参数化深度能量方法（CPDEM），这是一种纯物理驱动的框架，可高效求解具有随机材料参数的固体力学问题，避免了有限元方法重复网格划分的高昂计算成本、数据驱动代理模型对大规模数据集的依赖，以及标准深度能量方法在参数变化时需完全重新训练的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Constitutive Parameterized Deep Energy Method (CPDEM), a purely physics-driven framework that efficiently solves solid mechanics problems with random material parameters, eliminating the prohibitive computational cost of repeated FEM mesh discretization, the reliance on massive datasets in data-driven surrogates, and the need for complete retraining in standard deep energy methods when material parameters change.
